read: Read: the rally didn't end S&P hedging; it cheapened it. A 111k-lot November put position was moved from 3.6% to 5.6% below the price for a ~$12.7M credit, and 55.6k Nov-13 puts were sold against 70k open. Above, December $775 calls were sold. Same-day delta was bought, +$6.1B, as calls were chased into the close strikes. Positioning, not a signal.
